summary: Full backend + frontend E2E validation of the Lewi House major feature build. Backend: 31 pytest tests (/app/backend/tests/backend_test.py) covering JWT auth (401 unauth, login payload+httpOnly cookies, /auth/me, wrong password, invalid token, bcrypt $2b$ hash, brute-force lockout), seed counts (7 rooms/4 tenants/9 bills/3 tickets/3 tokens), room state machine (valid + invalid transitions, CRUD, dup name, bad ObjectId), tenant lifecycle (create->reserved, move-in->occupied + 6-digit PIN auto-issue, double move-in 400, move-out->former/cleaning/tokens revoked/refund math), bills (invoice number format, generate idempotency, partial->full payment, zero payment 400, overdue+dunning derivation, status filters), ticket transitions incl. invalid, access token issue/revoke/404, audit log, dashboard summary, monthly report => 30 passed, 1 xfail (documented lockout gap). Frontend (390x844 mobile): login redirect/login/logout/invalid-password error, dashboard (metrics, 6 room mini-stats, revenue chart, maintenance alert, 4-photo gallery all loading), Speed Dial FAB all 4 actions (record-payment auto-opens pay sheet on /bills, add-tenant, new-ticket, issue-token forms auto-open), Rooms filters + quick actions (room-ready-K-202 -> Tersedia, room-fixed-K-203 -> Dibersihkan, room-cancel-K-204 -> Tersedia), full tenant lifecycle via UI with KYC + rent auto-fill (Calon -> move-in Aktif + PIN token visible on /access -> move-out with deduction, refund preview Rp 900.000, Keluar), bills (generate invoices, partial payment then full payment -> Lunas, remaining-amount prefill, overdue Terlambat + Tahap 3 dunning, all 5 filters), tickets (create with category/priority, start->resolve->close, filters), access tokens (PIN hide/reveal toggle, issue new, revoke -> Dicabut), audit log page (15 entries incl. MASUK/PEMBAYARAN/CHECK-IN/CHECK-OUT/TERBIT TOKEN). Zero JS page errors; no failing API calls except the intentional 401.

minor.issue: Brute-force lockout is keyed on request.client.host:email. Behind the public ingress the client IP is the proxy pod and rotates, so 6+ wrong-password attempts through the preview URL never return 429 (verified: lockout only triggers when hitting the app directly on localhost:8001). Key the counter on email only (or X-Forwarded-For) to make the playbook lockout effective.

derive_bill() overwrites status 'partially_paid' with 'overdue' for past-due bills, so the partial-payment state is lost at read time. Consequence in UI: 'Sebagian' filter returns 0 cards and a partially paid overdue invoice shows only 'Terlambat'. Keep both (e.g. is_overdue flag + original status).
CORS_ORIGINS=* combined with allow_credentials=True; playbook requires explicit origin list when credentials/cookies are used.
Always return {ok:true} even when nothing was deleted (no 404 on missing id). Deleting an occupied room also leaves tenant.room_id dangling.
Raw ObjectId(prev_room)/ObjectId(room_id) calls on stored/foreign ids are not wrapped by the oid() helper -> 500 on malformed value.

ui_bugs.issue: Reset/reseed data is only reachable when the DB is completely empty (seed-btn renders only if s.rooms_total === 0), so the requested 'reset + reseed' action is unusable on a populated database. Testing agents/users must call POST /api/seed manually.
A partially paid but past-due invoice shows only the 'Terlambat' badge; the amount already paid / 'Sebagian' state is not surfaced on the card (backend derivation, see backend_issues).

issues: 'PENDAPATAN BULAN INI' label (white/70 uppercase) sits over the bright part of the property photo -> poor contrast, nearly unreadable; add a stronger gradient scrim
'SELAMAT DATANG / Lewi House' block sits close to the floating action icons (key/history/logout) on 390px width
Amount wraps awkwardly ('Rp' on one line, number on the next) at 390px because the serif size is too large for the half-width card
Mobile-first column is centered with large empty beige gutters and a very tall empty hero region above the form - acceptable for a PWA but visually sparse on desktop

action_items: Make brute-force lockout effective behind the ingress (key on email, or trust X-Forwarded-For)
Preserve partial-payment state when deriving overdue status (add is_overdue/dunning without clobbering 'partially_paid') so the 'Sebagian' bill filter works
Expose a reset/reseed control that is always available (currently hidden unless rooms_total === 0)
Set explicit CORS origins instead of '*' since allow_credentials=True
Return 404 from DELETE endpoints when the document does not exist and block deleting an occupied room
Wrap all ObjectId(...) conversions with the oid() helper to avoid 500s on malformed ids
Improve dashboard hero contrast (scrim behind 'PENDAPATAN BULAN INI') and fix the 'Belum Bayar' amount wrapping
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 972 lines - split into routers (auth, rooms, tenants, bills, maintenance, access, dashboard, seed) per the <700-line guideline

Enum-like fields (room_type, bill payment method, ticket category/priority, token_type) are plain str in Pydantic models - use Literal and ge=0 for money fields; POST /api/bills/{id}/payments currently accepts any method string
List endpoints use hard-coded to_list(1000/2000) with no pagination - will silently truncate at scale
POST /api/seed wipes rooms/tenants/bills/complaints/access_tokens AND audit_logs for any authenticated user; consider owner-role-only + confirmation flag
Access token PINs are returned in plaintext from GET /api/access-tokens (fine for demo, but should be hashed/masked server-side for production)

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (2 non-blocking UX gaps)

All flows in the review request were exercised and pass; open items are the lockout-behind-proxy gap, overdue-overwrites-partially_paid, hidden reseed control and dashboard hero contrast.
rca_of_the_issue: 1) Lockout gap: login_attempts identifier = f"{request.client.host}:{email}"; through the Kubernetes ingress request.client.host is the proxy pod IP which rotates, so the counter never reaches 5 for one identifier (proved by 6 sequential wrong-password calls to localhost:8001 returning 429 vs public URL returning 401 each time). 2) Missing 'Sebagian' bills: derive_bill() unconditionally sets status='overdue' when status != 'paid' and due_date < today, so the stored 'partially_paid' value is replaced before serialization and the frontend filter (status === 'partially_paid') matches nothing.
